# WhatWeb

`whatweb` &middot; _information-gathering_

Fingerprints the technologies behind a website (CMS, frameworks, servers).

**Moderate impact.** It touches the target directly; keep the scope tight.

## What this tool needs

- The URL of a site you are authorised to test.
- Ruby (bundled in the runtime image).

## How to use it

Enter a URL. WhatWeb reports the server, CMS, JavaScript libraries and header hints it recognises. Aggression level 1 (the default) is a single polite request; higher levels send more probes.

## Examples

```console
$ https://example.com
```

## At a glance

- Category: `information-gathering`
- Install with: `apt install whatweb`
